summary: Scene has only a private Fable packaging dependency and no Game, Audio or Governance project dependency. Its curated Fable project includes canonical types, retained/document/spatial/workspace/animation contracts but excludes .NET codec, inspection and text-shaping implementations. Scene.SvgBrowser builds on Scene and KeyboardInput plus Browser.Dom; SkiaViewer owns the native Skia/OpenGL/window/font closure. Repository-wide independence must not be generalized to every generated profile: template pins explicitly compose published Game, Audio and Contracts packages. Read project references and curated sources rather than treating README-level repository independence as every adapter's dependency graph.
title: Portable Scene is distinct from native viewer and composed profiles
